questions.label: How do I use my medicine?
questions.responseTitle: A pharmacist can walk through the label with you
questions.responseBody: Bring the medicine, its label, and any written instructions to a pharmacist. They can explain the directions in a way that fits your situation.
questions.nextStep: Open Pharmacy Services to find the right place to ask.

questions.label: I missed a dose
questions.responseTitle: Pause before taking an extra dose
questions.responseBody: The safest next step depends on the medicine and how late the dose is. Check the label and speak with a pharmacist or healthcare professional for medicine-specific guidance.
questions.nextStep: Use the counselling pathway for a careful answer.

questions.label: Can I combine medicines?
questions.responseTitle: A pharmacist should check the combination
questions.responseBody: Do not assume that two medicines are safe together. Bring a complete list of medicines and supplements so a pharmacist can check for interactions.

questions.label: I may have taken the wrong medicine
questions.responseBody: If you may have taken the wrong medicine or an unsafe amount, contact urgent medical services or a poison and medication safety service immediately. Do not wait for an online reply.
questions.nextStep: If there are severe symptoms, call emergency services now.

questions.label: I am worried about a side effect
questions.responseTitle: A pharmacist can help you decide the next safe step
questions.responseBody: Describe what happened, when it began, and which medicines you used. Severe symptoms or breathing difficulty need urgent medical attention.
questions.nextStep: Prepare your medicine list and contact a healthcare professional.
